title: Agentic Context Management for Multi-Turn Human-AI Conversations
abstract: arXiv:2611.00518v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLMs degrade in multi-turn conversation partly because of context pollution: the model's own earlier outputs stay in context and anchor later turns, so an early misreading of the user's intent can persist after the user corrects it. Assistant omission (AO), dropping every assistant message, removes this pollution but fails when interaction is referential: later turns refer back to drafts, decisions, and tool-call results that exist only in assistant turns. We propose Agentic Conversation Context Curation (AC3), a training-free method in which a separate analyzer (1) consolidates the task specification from the user's messages alone, (2) audits the assistant's prior outputs against it, and (3) edits the context, either appending the analysis or discarding the assistant side and rebuilding the context from the specification. translated_title: 面向多轮人机对话的智能体上下文管理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在多轮对话中性能下降的部分原因在于“上下文污染”：模型自身先前的输出会保留在上下文中并锚定后续轮次，因此即使用户已纠正了早期对意图的误读，这种误读仍可能持续存在。助手消息省略（AO）通过丢弃所有助手消息来消除这种污染，但在交互具有指涉性时会失效：后续轮次会回指仅存在于助手轮次中的草稿、决策和工具调用结果。我们提出了智能体对话上下文策展（AC3），这是一种无需训练的方法，由一个独立的分析器（1）仅从用户消息中整合任务规范，（2）据此审查助手的先前输出，（3）编辑上下文——或附加分析结果，或丢弃助手侧内容并依据任务规范重建上下文。第二个发现：污染具有传染性。一个在提取任务规范时看到助手推理过程的分析器……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出无需训练的智能体对话上下文策展方法AC3，由独立分析器仅从用户消息整合任务规范、审查助手先前输出并据此编辑上下文，从而解决多轮对话中的上下文污染问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes AC3, a training-free agentic context curation method in which a separate analyzer consolidates the task specification from user messages alone, audits prior assistant outputs, and edits the context to mitigate context pollution in multi-turn conversations.
